summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. and Brookfield Renewable Corp filed a Form 6-K containing a press release dated July 31, 2026, reporting second-quarter 2026 financial results. The release highlights record FFO of $421 million or $0.62 per unit, up 13% year-over-year, and mentions the recent acquisition of Aypa, the largest standalone battery storage platform in North America, and a realized gain on sale of a 25% interest in non-core U.S. hydro assets. No specific deal terms, prices, premiums, or tender/activist activity are disclosed. This is a routine earnings report, not a special-situations event.
